title: Remove the retired generation and occasion blocks from app/globals.css
detail:
SCAN-1130 closed on its probe (no LEGACY_THEME_AXES reader or export). What it left: the generation and occasion selector blocks in app/globals.css (31 [data-generation] / [data-occasion] hits), then skins other than Default and Midnight, then design-fonts/dawn. Nothing sets data-generation or data-occasion any more (resolveTheme returns the default generation and occasion 'none'), so the blocks are dead CSS. Midnight is live: keep it. Delete the blocks, keep the Frequency tokens, and recapture visual baselines if any move.

Retirement completed in the isolated audit candidate: removed all generation/occasion selector rules, kept Default/Midnight, structure and Space-theme rules, and retargeted duration cancellation to :root while preserving pulse/spin cancellation. Historical IDs, cookie validation/serialization, Space values and janitor data are retained; tests exercise every saved generation/occasion combination through the actual resolver and require balanced/none with the member skin preserved. Correction to the original inventory: the member layout still stamps balanced on html, but no nondefault generation or non-none occasion reaches the active shell. The registry contains only Default/Midnight skins, both retained. Empty DAWN font stub retirement is separately HYG191. Owner-probe subprocess controls reject three restored selector forms. Live Frequency contrast thresholds and frozen waiver floors remain unchanged; retired non-rendered AAA states are parser fixtures, not live claims. Compiled-stylesheet browser parity is separate from full-route/device/font acceptance.

verify.note: Passes after removal; 77 focused tests include actual resolver compatibility and owner-probe mutation controls. CLI contrast: 758 pairs across 9 base/Frequency states, with live thresholds unchanged.
